sources.title: omurberaisik/NoTokenLM-Gen-3.5 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Head-to-head: this model vs. its predecessor (NoTokenLM-Gen-2.5) We compared this model against its direct predecessor (Gen-2.5, ~3.1M parameters, GPT-2-style architecture: GELU, LayerNorm, learned position embeddings) on 8 held-out English sentences the models weren't trained on, by loading both models' raw weights directly and checking which one predicts each sentence better.
